newsitem.title: MEXICO: Three Mexicans arrested in alleged financial scam.
newsitem.headline: Three Mexicans arrested in alleged financial scam.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry on Thursday said three men were arrested in connection with an alleged misappropriation of funds at agricultural insurance firm Agroasemex.
The ministry said in a statement that it had asked the Attorney General's Office to investigate two Agroasemex executives and a salesman at Estrategia Bursatil brokerage firm in the case.
The Finance Ministry said it was taking the recommendation of the National Insurance Commission by passing the case on to criminal authorities.

The commission had received a complaint of possible violations from the company against the three men under arrest: Agroasemex financial officers Rafael Escobedo Vzquez and Antonio Lpez Andrs plus Luis Javier Prez Romo of the Estrategia Burstil brokerage firm.
No one could be reached for comment at either company after business hours.

The ministry said the three men conspired to arrange a deal in which Agroasemex bought various forms of debt paper from the brokerage firm "at a price 40 percent higher than the prevailing price on the market, causing heavy losses of approximately threee million pesos to the insurer."
